reviews.title: RARELY WORKS
reviews.text: On day one, only one of the two local scanner options were streaming. Even at that, only 6 listeners were streaming, which was my first indication that this scanner was not as popular and/or reliable enough to draw in more of an audience. I thought it  may be due to the difference between a subscribed listener verses a non-subscriber. I purchased the yearly subscription. Doing so made no difference whatsoever. In fact, by the time the subscription had been approved, there were only 3 listeners and the other channel was still offline. At any given moment, the only two channels available have been offline more than not. While emergency responders could be heard nearing my neighborhood yesterday, I tuned into this so-called Police Scanner app for emergency alerts. Again, both channels were offline, and there was not one ‘alert’ available! In summary, it would have been as informative to have lit on fire the $39, than to have paid for a subscription to this “scanner”.  I would have at least watched my money go up in smoke! Certainly this scanner would not have recognized  it nor streamed it as a fire emergency… the app is always offline!
